content: Jona Nak Sank Wank Naremp Wulapm Weink
Jona ar oyokn mankluel, kil ka antemp Wulapm Weink nak sank.

Kil nak na, “Sepmel, apm kipe ka ninkemp wankepm suknelel aser apm markipniminket yiknel. Yikn ka eipm apm. Apm ka nak nana apm ka apei yemp ka nuarep yemp oumpel ka nti omoule awurel arel. Kakilpe apm ninkitepm yikn, aser yikn oupmueipm apm.
Nti ka sop upuikn aiyiknel, ka nti wat apm amu mpep niopmel. Niopm atit aryamuwi apm.

Mpuas niopmel ka kitip apm amamp, yapm apm kako nkutonk. Apm o..o..o..o..o amu malenk kitapm ka apei niopm kipmin. Nti muanumpuor yemp oumpelel ka narkimp apm. Apm ka nak na ka yikn ka karep nkimer apm, apm korokn nimpil ser yikn, aser rokn. Sepmel, yikn ka Wulapm Weink ankil, ka apm aki nio aiyiknel sitel. Yikn naimpil nkamump apm, apul apm awemp yemp oumpel apmoi. Apm karokn wuntu, apm ka pirpm. Apm kako nimpil yiki nio aiyiknel yopmoi yetne suknel ntinkiraiel aiyiknel.
Wulapm Weink, yapmonemp apmelel apm nak nana apm'a wuntuel, aser apm wonempwamiyimp yikn, markipninket yikn. Ma apmelel yikn opmueipm apmoi yetne suknel aiyiknel.
Nti omoule ka akei salpiknin kitapmel nkaelel, nti karokn omoule aiyiknel, et yikn kakorokn yupul nti sepm.

Aser apm karokn. Apm'a yekei wampen yiki nio aiyiknel, apm'a wul oumpiepm nio yuwa yikn. Sinsi mimi apm nakimp yiknel, kako apm yumpul. Sepmel, yikn lekekn ka nkamp an omoule eikusukn ar yemp kuoretelel, et yikn apul an naimpil ar sepmel.”
Epe Wulapm Weink eipm sank ka Jona nakel, kil apul oyokn la aikulp Jona nkupmus niopm eikriekn.
